text:
DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSES OF CHRONIC STABLE ANGINA (ANGINA PECTORIS)
- Pulmonary embolism
- Gastro-esophageal reflux disease (GERD)
- Pericarditis
- Aortic dissection
- Mitral valve prolapse syndrome
- Esophageal spasm
- Costochondritis
